ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximate 45% high-intensity white pixels to 55% low-intensity black/dark-gray pixels across the visible ventral fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Two large, high-contrast white contiguous regions located on the distal portions of the left and right lobes, separated by a dominant low-intensity black central region extending from the peduncle to the trailing edge. High-intensity areas are characterized by irregular black mottling at the margins.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: V-shaped central depression with an estimated internal angle of 65 degrees; the vertex of the notch is partially obscured by water turbulence at the peduncle interface.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular serration along the entire trailing edge; frequency of peaks increases towards the tips, with vertical amplitudes ranging from 3 to 10 pixels relative to the edge baseline.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex curve along the outer margins of both lobes, tapering to acute, slightly upward-curled tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Scattered low-intensity (dark) pixel clusters on the high-intensity (white) background of the left lobe; no distinct circular barnacle attachment scars confirmed.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Single distinct orange-tinted focal spot (potential lesion or diatom accumulation) located on the upper-medial quadrant of the right lobe's white region.
